cc:Work.dc:description: Feasible total forward-force and residual yaw-moment diamonds for independent signed left/right bounds ±12 kN, half-track 0.8 m and a fixed 10 kN forward jet. A centred jet leaves the moment centre at zero; a jet at y=0.6 m translates it to -6 kNm. Their zero-yaw maximum forward forces are 34 and 26.5 kN. This relaxed envelope includes braking but omits real motor topology, slip, power and rate constraints.
